question: The Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) which is a National Research Institute for space and allied sciences, is situated at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Physical Research Laboratory (PRL)** was established in **1947 **by **Dr. Vikram Sarabhai **and plays a significant role in research related to space and allied sciences.
 
• The laboratory aims to promote research in space and allied sciences, including astronomy, astrophysics, atmospheric sciences, and space technology.
 
• It has been involved in significant projects, such as the Mars Orbiter Mission (**Mangalyaan**) and the Indian Space Research Organisation's (ISRO) satellite programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**Sarabhai was instrumental in establishing the Indian National Committee for Space Research (**INCOSPAR**) in **1962**, which laid the groundwork for the Indian Space Research Organisation (**ISRO**) in **1969**.
